title: AMI Meeting Corpus, manual annotations 1.6.2 (CC BY 4.0), dialogue acts of its scenario test partition

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
licence.citation: Carletta et al., The AMI Meeting Corpus: A Pre-announcement, MLMI 2005; AMI Consortium, ami_public_manual_1.6.2

comment: What a line asks of its reader, as AMI's annotators marked each dialogue act. Its classes are the general-purpose communicative functions of ISO 24617-2 (Bunt et al.): Inform provides information (a fact); the Elicit acts seek it (a question); Suggest is a directive and Offer a commissive, both an action someone is to take (a task). Backchannels, stalls, fragments, assessments and social acts ask nothing of the owner and are not mapped. train: the series of AMI's scenario training partition, whose acts the intent head is fit on (test/oracle/intent.test.mjs, INTENT_FIT); they never enter the repository, only the head's weights do.
